plan_area_inventory.title: Explicit /auto inputs for fix all OPEN bugs or fix BUG-nnnn
Resume and phase schedule bind to BUG ids and ordered execution
Interaction with AUTO_BACKLOG_DRAIN US-0044 and resume_brief DEC-0069
Reference doc, auto.md, template parity, regression tests

topic_coverage.quoted_user_text: Add /auto capability to explicitly target defects: phrases or flags like fix all bugs or fix BUG-0008 so the orchestrator runs the full lifecycle phases for every OPEN bug or for one chosen bug, instead of only story-centric backlog drain.
Cursor-hosted agents and optional CI; same repo as its-magic; merged scratchpad and handoffs/resume_brief.md; canonical backlog BUG section in docs/product/backlog.md.
Extend existing Markdown commands (.cursor/commands/auto.md), auto-orchestration-reference.md, Python contract tests, scratchpad keys; no new runtime language.

Deterministic argv or scratchpad keys (e.g. AUTO_BUG_TARGET) parsed before resume precedence; queue OPEN bugs by id; intersect phase plan US-0070; spawn-only orchestration unchanged US-0069; fail-closed reason codes for unknown id or empty queue.
CLI-only: documented /auto syntax examples, help text, deterministic errors (unknown BUG id, no OPEN bugs, conflict with AUTO_BACKLOG_DRAIN story selection).
No elevated trust: bug targeting only selects backlog rows already authorized by operator; no auto-closure without passing QA/release gates; secrets and isolation contracts unchanged.

Bounded runs: max bugs per segment, stop/skip policy, clear breadcrumbs in state.md and resume_brief; must not false-trigger RESUME_BRIEF_STALE DEC-0069; compatibility with DEC-0022 story drain when both off by default.
Single story US-0087 for command contract + reference + tests + scratchpad template parity; architecture section # US-0087; optional follow-on only if sprint sizing forces split.
